parameters.content:
## Forecast stockouts and draft purchase orders with Gemini and Sheets

### How it works
Running out of stock costs sales; over-ordering ties up cash. Every morning this template reads your inventory sheet and a Code node does the planning maths for each SKU: daily sales velocity, days of cover left, a reorder point based on the supplier lead time with a safety buffer, and a suggested order quantity to reach 30 days of cover. A Basic LLM Chain with Google Gemini then writes a short purchase recommendation that says plainly whether stock will run out before a delivery could arrive, how much to order and when, plus one risk to check. Stockout risks alert the operations channel and prepare a supplier PO draft in Gmail; low stock sends a reorder notice; and every SKU is written back with its cover, reorder point and status. Items alerted in the last three days are skipped so nobody is spammed.

### Setup
1. Connect Google Sheets, Google Gemini (PaLM) API, Gmail and Slack.
2. Give the Inventory sheet columns: SKU, Product, Stock On Hand, Weekly Sales, Lead Time Days, Unit Cost, Supplier, Supplier Email, Last Alert.
3. Set the buyer email and pick your Slack channel.

### Customization tips
Pull stock from Shopify instead, or auto-send the PO once a human approves it.

## 1. Read stock & do the maths
Compute daily velocity, days of cover, a lead-time-aware reorder point and the suggested order quantity. Recently alerted SKUs are skipped.

## 2. Recommend (Basic LLM Chain)
Gemini turns the numbers into a plain recommendation: order how much, when, and what to watch out for.

## 3. Act & write back
Stockout risk alerts Slack and drafts a supplier PO; low stock emails the buyer. Every SKU row gets its cover, reorder point and status.
